This indicates that the flavonoid may influence SNU1 through a cascade involving UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1-8, potentially modulating the metabolic fate of SNU1 or other compounds. The evidence supports a mechanistic pathway where the flavonoid acts as a substrate or inhibitor of a key enzyme that interacts with SNU1, suggesting a possible role in regulating SNU1 activity or function.
